reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Multilateral governance to mitigate AI risks
themes.definition: Commitment to build multilateral AI governance to mitigate AI risks, aligned with the Global Digital Compact.
themes.inclusion: Include passages pledging multilateral AI governance as a risk-mitigation measure.
themes.exclusion: Exclude domestic digital regulation that does not address AI governance internationally.
themes.boundary_cases: Explicit reference to the Global Digital Compact also fits AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: To mitigate the risks of artificial intelligence, we are committed to building multilateral governance in line with the global digital compact

themes.label: Global Digital Compact as reference framework
themes.definition: UN Global Digital Compact invoked as the framework for AI governance.
themes.inclusion: Include passages anchoring AI governance in the GDC or other UN instruments.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief GDC mention inside a national digital-policy passage still counts.

examples.quote: in line with the global digital compact that was approved in this plenary last year

themes.label: Domestic digital laws around AI
themes.definition: National legislative measures in the digital sphere adjacent to AI: child online protection, digital market competition and sustainable data centres.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing national laws or bills on digital markets, data centres or online child protection presented alongside AI policy.
themes.exclusion: Exclude national AI investment boasts without regulatory content (AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: Child online-protection laws also fit AI_CHILD_PROTECTION if AI harms are explicit.

examples.quote: we sent draft bills to the National Congress to foster competition and digital markets and to encourage the installation of sustainable data centers

value.rationale: Single Brazilian passage: AI appears briefly within a digital-policy paragraph, pairing domestic digital regulation with a commitment to multilateral AI governance under the Global Digital Compact, before moving to regional security.
